name: fs_file
doc: One slot of the file handle table. nxnative keeps the open mode and the transaction of a file in arrays indexed by host fd and tells an image entry by a bit of the handle; here the slot's state says what the handle is. OpenRead, OpenWrite (write only: opened with Write or AllowAppend and without Read) and OpenReadWrite are files of a save; OpenImageEntry is a file of a RomFS image (read only, no storage object of its own). Stale: the save was rebuilt from its committed version while the handle was open (a refused commit); every operation fails until it is closed.
